query:
SELECT
            a.public_id,
            o.blake3_hash,
            o.storage_key,
            o.media_type,
            o.size_bytes,
            s.original_filename as "original_filename?",
            a.created_at
        FROM assets a
        JOIN originals o ON o.id = a.original_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT original_filename
            FROM asset_sources
            WHERE asset_id = a.id
            ORDER BY created_at ASC
            LIMIT 1
        ) s ON true
        WHERE a.owner_id = $1
          AND a.trashed_at IS NULL
        ORDER BY a.created_at ASC, a.public_id ASC
